title: Creative AI for editable media, sound and physical practice
summary: Today’s expanded research covers 54 creative fields, including paper engineering. It completes earlier screened guides and adds researched tools across media, agent authoring and interactive practice. All entries distinguish software licenses from models, assets and services; no discovered software was installed or run. A focused FastGS reassessment reopens its license check because a core source notice conflicts with the root license. Quality labels reflect available evidence, not popularity. The library gains 51 distinct tools; 14 earlier screened entries become full guides. The complete discovery catalog and retained backlog received bounded metadata review beyond the automatic README shortlist, including a final pass after collection; raw unreviewed matches remain private. All 401 planned repository queries and 17 model tasks were attempted successfully. 105 repository searches reached their result bounds, so coverage is not exhaustive. The configured watchlist also had a repeated unavailable-repository lookup. All eight configured web ecosystems have researched findings; several project pages returned script shells or failed in the research browser, with direct primary reads used where available. Model metadata is a discovery signal, not permission to publish unreviewed software.
